name: motion-depth-zoom
title: Depth Zoom
description: Thẻ từ rất nhỏ và nhoè lao tới, phóng vượt cỡ gốc lên 135 % và rõ nét dần.

moworks.author: moworks

options.to: ends larger than its layout size (1.35)
options.exitAt: s after the start to fade (null)

credit.author: Moworks Studio

moworks.notes: Card scales about its centre 0.15 → 1.35 (ends larger than its layout size), blur 6 → 0 px and opacity 0.2 → 1, together in 740 ms power4.inOut (easeInOutQuint). Small demo: fade in over the first 250 ms of the loop; exit fade 300 ms power2.in. Perspective guide lines are not ported. Params: duration (0.74 s) · scale (0.15 → 1.35) · blur (6 px) · ease (power4.inOut).
